phase of Ariane 6, from cryogenic technology to gas supply.

Performing with impact

Air Liquide, it’s a story of essential molecules. Molecules… Pure, invisible molecules essential to
life, matter, energy.

Oxygen, Nitrogen, Helium, Argon, Hydrogen, CO2

From oxygen that heals, to nitrogen that protects, up to hydrogen that propels the future…

Our gases are at the heart of your everyday life.

Our technologies help improve our customers’ processes.

Our technologies help reduce CO2 emissions.

Our services contribute to improving quality of life.

We’re tackling the challenges of our time (Digital / Health / Energy).

Since 1902, we've been constantly innovating, in our Innovation Campuses, and demonstrating our
relevance, leveraging digital.

+5,600 dedicated employees

320 patent applications

3.5bn data points analyzed/day

We produce locally, close to our customers.

In 59 countries

We build long-term partnerships

80,000 suppliers

We serve a wide variety of sectors, from multinationals to local craftspeople, from hospitals to
your neighbor.

+2m customers

~2.3m patients

We build ecosystems and mobilize all the local players, to develop solutions for the future.

Hydrogen for industry

Hydrogen for mobility

With our Shareholders, we move forward with confidence.

~970,000 individual Shareholders

We combine financial and extra-financial performance

€26.9bn sales

€3.5bn net income

€4.2bn investment decisions

-13% in CO2 emissions (vs 2020)

34%

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

## Our technology

More than 50 years of fuel cell technology innovation and expertise.

[fuel-cell-technology-patents-1]

Patents are for FuelCell Energy, Inc., including our subsidiary Versa Power Systems, Inc.

## Energy has a bright future

Fuel cells are efficient, scalable energy platforms that deliver steady, clean baseload
power—running on natural gas, alternative fuels/biofuels, or hydrogen. They operate quietly, cut
emissions significantly compared to traditional sources, and offer combined heat and power (CHP) for
added efficiency.

At FuelCell Energy, we deploy these solutions worldwide, powering industries, utilities, campuses,
and communities while also capturing carbon and producing hydrogen—ready today and built for
tomorrow.

# Eco Energy International® is Powering the Future!

#### Cost Effective, Eco-Friendly, Energy Solutions

### [Cost Effective, Eco-Friendly Hydrogen Production][48]
* [[eco h2]][49]The demand for merchant market hydrogen (H2) is expected to grow twenty-fold by the
  year 2030.
* States like California are now requiring that upwards of 33% of all H2 must be produced from
  renewable sources.
* Utilizing various biogenic feedstocks to make H2  producing clean fuel at a lower cost compared to
  traditional methods.
* Eco H2 bio reformation produces hydrogen from renewables and:
  * – can produce hydrogen competitive to large scale reformers
  * – is modular and scalable to meet almost any demand
  * – can be located near end use reducing transportation costs
  * – sequesters all carbon resulting in a negative carbon footprint
  * – byproduct carbonate can be sold, landfilled or recycled
  * – can use solid, gaseous and liquid renewable feedstocks

### [Renewable Diesel Fuel from Municipal Solid Waste, Biomass or other Carbon Sources][50]

EEI’s patented Bio-Carbon driers are part of a process to revolutionize fuel production. Municipal
Solid Waste (MSW) is processed into Diesel to reduce waste disposal issues while outputting fuel.

**Advantages of EEI’s Renewable Diesel Process:**[[Bio Carbon Fuels]][51]
* * Unlike Bio-Diesel, Renewable diesel doesn’t contain ­oxygen, meaning it does not have a few of
    the downsides of bio-diesel.
    • higher freezing temperature
    •  Storeable for  longer periods before separating.
  * Renewable diesel has the same chemical structure as petroleum diesel, so it can be used in
    engines designed for petroleum diesel fuels.
  * No need to blend Renewable Diesel with fossil-fuel diesel.
  * Renewable diesel also burns cleaner, with less pollution, than biodiesel or petroleum fuels.
  * production is modular and scale-able to meet almost any demand
  * production can be located near end use, reducing transportation costs

### Hydrogen Market Forces & Forecast
* Historically, the hydrogen energy market has been centered on the petroleum refinery and chemical
  manufacturing sectors.
* “Increased energy demand, requirements to use renewable energy, growth in the cleantech backup
  power market, and the deployment of a growing number of fuel cell-powered vehicles in the
  transport sector will all push overall demand for hydrogen as a fuel to unprecedented
  levels.”-*Kerry-Ann Adamson,  Navigant*
*  According to a recent report from Navigant Research, hydrogen consumption for non-traditional
  applications (outside the petroleum and chemical sectors) will grow from 168 million kilograms in
  2013 to nearly 3.5 billion kilograms in 2030.
* States are starting to mandate that 33% of all H2 production be from renewable sources: commonly
  called “green” hydrogen
* Today most of the hydrogen is produced using Steam Methane Reformers (SMR) which use non-renewable
  natural gas as the feedstock: that is why it is referred to as “brown” hydrogen
* SMR technology produces large amounts of CO2 (greenhouse gas) as a by-product
* SMRs must be large, centralized plants to be economical resulting in high transportation costs to
  the merchant market
* Navigant Research forecasts a 20 fold increase in the H2 merchant market to $50 billion by 2030
  with stationary fuel cells, fuel cell vehicles and energy storage being major contributors.

Solid Waste (MSW) is processed into Diesel to reduce waste disposal issues while outputting fuel.

**Advantages of EEI’s Renewable Diesel Process:**[[Bio Carbon Fuels]][51]
* * Unlike Bio-Diesel, Renewable diesel doesn’t contain ­oxygen, meaning it does not have a few of
    the downsides of bio-diesel.
    • higher freezing temperature
    •  Storeable for  longer periods before separating.
  * Renewable diesel has the same chemical structure as petroleum diesel, so it can be used in
    engines designed for petroleum diesel fuels.
  * No need to blend Renewable Diesel with fossil-fuel diesel.
  * Renewable diesel also burns cleaner, with less pollution, than biodiesel or petroleum fuels.
  * production is modular and scale-able to meet almost any demand
  * production can be located near end use, reducing transportation costs

### Hydrogen Market Forces & Forecast
* Historically, the hydrogen energy market has been centered on the petroleum refinery and chemical
  manufacturing sectors.
* “Increased energy demand, requirements to use renewable energy, growth in the cleantech backup
  power market, and the deployment of a growing number of fuel cell-powered vehicles in the
  transport sector will all push overall demand for hydrogen as a fuel to unprecedented
  levels.”-*Kerry-Ann Adamson,  Navigant*
*  According to a recent report from Navigant Research, hydrogen consumption for non-traditional
  applications (outside the petroleum and chemical sectors) will grow from 168 million kilograms in
  2013 to nearly 3.5 billion kilograms in 2030.
* States are starting to mandate that 33% of all H2 production be from renewable sources: commonly
  called “green” hydrogen
* Today most of the hydrogen is produced using Steam Methane Reformers (SMR) which use non-renewable
  natural gas as the feedstock: that is why it is referred to as “brown” hydrogen
* SMR technology produces large amounts of CO2 (greenhouse gas) as a by-product
* SMRs must be large, centralized plants to be economical resulting in high transportation costs to
  the merchant market
* Navigant Research forecasts a 20 fold increase in the H2 merchant market to $50 billion by 2030
  with stationary fuel cells, fuel cell vehicles and energy storage being major contributors.

### [Introducing Base Facilitated Reformation (BFR)][52]
* [[process flow]][53]We have developed the eco-friendly reformation process to produce
  high purity hydrogen from a wide variety of renewable feedstocks:
  thus it is considered “green” hydrogen
* The BFR process has no greenhouse gas emissions (no CO or CO2 released into the atmosphere) making
  it even more eco-friendly
* The BFR process is modular and scalable allowing hydrogen production near the point of use,
  minimizing transportation costs
* BFR delivered hydrogen costs to the end customer are far less than traditional merchant hydrogen

# Your shift to clean energy starts here

Decarbonize your business with advanced zero-emissions technologies that deliver reliable,
sustainable power.

[European zero-emissions truck cab]

## Customize your power solution

We know there's no one-size-fits-all solution for decarbonization, so we built a broad portfolio of
electric for commercial transportation and industrial applications.

[
[Product rendering of a 3-tier battery for commercial vehicles]

Battery systems

][30] [

Electric motors

Streamline mobility demand challenges with advanced electric motors that don't sacrifice quality or
power.

ePowertrain systems

We're on a mission to make clean power the new normal for the industries that keep the world
running.

Accelera is built by purpose-driven teams of engineers, scientists, strategists and manufacturers
laying the foundation for a new green energy economy that will secure a sustainable future, today.

# Alpha 50

## ALPHA 50, The plant that changes everything. Large Scale Project Execution Redefined.

Meet the world's first full-scope
50 MW Green Hydrogen plant.

Powered by our state-of-the-art TRIDENT stack platform, ALPHA 50 produces high-purity hydrogen at 30
bar pressure. ALPHA 50 offers superior energy efficiency and is capable of load changes within
seconds to maximise hydrogen output.

50 MEGAWATTS

900 KG/HR H2

80 TRIDENT STACKS

### Green Hydrogen, produced by PEM electrolysers and powered by renewable energy is the only
### net-zero fuel source. 

 

### Unlike other fuels, it doesn’t remove oxygen from the atmosphere – or add more water vapour to
### the atmosphere than it consumes during production – which helps retain the earth’s existing
### oxygen and water balance. 

 

### What’s more, it has no negative impact on air quality.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]

## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

[Learn More][80]

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help

applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

### Realize LIVE 2026 | Global events

register now.

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.

  ### Upstream
  
  Focused on strengthening energy security by expanding low-cost-of-supply, high-return oil and
  natural gas operations.
  
  [Learn more about our Upstream business][124]
* [Female engineer working in Baytown Technology and Engineering Complex]
  
  ### Product Solutions
  
  Integrating our downstream and chemical operations to develop lower-emission fuels and innovative
  products critical to modern society.

  [Learn more about our Chemical business][126]
* [Scientist working in a lab]
  
  ### Low Carbon Solutions
  
  Helping reduce emissions by providing solutions to our industrial and commercial customers in
  growing markets for carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and biofuels.
  
  [Learn more about our Low Carbon Solutions business][127]

## Our global brands

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.

  natural gas operations.

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.
